prompt: Our onboarding flow has a 60% drop-off at the account-verification step. We've already tried shortening the form and adding a progress bar. I'm out of ideas — what else could we do?
assertions: Distinguishes between possible CAUSES of the drop-off before proposing fixes, rather than going straight to an idea list
Raises that the 60% may be composed of different populations, or may be partly a measurement or attribution artifact
Does not re-propose shortening the form or adding a progress bar
At least one option questions whether verification needs to happen at that point in the flow at all
Options differ in mechanism (channel, timing, who verifies, whether to verify) rather than in copy, layout, or visual design
Handles the ambiguity in 'account-verification' — either asks which kind, or states which reading it assumed and what would change under the others
Proportionate to a bounded product question: under roughly 1200 words, no ceremonial section headings with no content under them
MODE CHECK: did NOT run a full deep multi-agent pass with parallel generators and web research on this bounded problem
